description: Defines an immutable data class representing repayment schedule details related to a loan, including disbursement dates, currency, principal, and fee charges.

classes.name: RepaymentScheduleRelatedLoanData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing repayment schedule related information.

methods.name: disbursementDate
methods.description: Returns the effective disbursement date, prioritizing actual disbursement date if available.

methods.name: isDisbursed
methods.description: Checks if the loan has been disbursed based on the presence of an actual disbursement date.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with the loan.

methods.name: getTotalFeeChargesAtDisbursement
methods.description: Returns total fee charges at disbursement.

methods.name: disbursementData
methods.description: Creates and returns a DisbursementData object with disbursement details.
